Market today: The market's mood is jittery, driven by the hot jobs report and rising yields. This is a headwind for growth and tech names, especially those on margin.

Your holdings: SOXL is still a major concern (-54.46%). SMH (-11.3%) and QQQI (-3.15%) are also underperforming and flagged for attention. CRWD is your only significant winner (+18.28%).

Watch: Keep an eye on the 2-year yield and any further Fed rate hike expectations.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged and underperforming tech positions.
plays: SOXL: This is a SELL signal. Consider trimming or exiting given the significant loss and leveraged nature.
SMH: This is a TRIM signal. Evaluate reducing exposure given the current drawdown.
QQQI: This is a TRIM signal. Consider trimming if you need to reduce overall tech concentration.
